<thought>We need to determine the number of unique proton environments. The tool proton_nmr_spectra can provide the 1H NMR spectrum for the current compound, which will list the distinct signals. By counting the signals we get the number of chemically equivalent hydrogen types. No arguments are required.</thought>
<action>proton_nmr_spectra</action>
<action_input>{}</action_input>
